info.title: CF Meet public API — communications
info.description: Personal communications identity, contacts, privacy and (Sections 9-23) unified Chats, Calls, Contacts, Meetings and Settings facades. Existing Account authentication is authoritative. Calling, Messaging and Meetings remain the owners of calls, messages and meetings; these operations are authorized facades, per-user preferences and read models. No phone OTP or phone-number discovery. Internal policy, principal, lifecycle and operator APIs are private and excluded.
